Scene 01
The Last Breath
Music
Solo piano at a breath-like tempo — very slow, sparse, notes separated by long silences. Heavy reverb tail, as if heard from another room. Dry and hollow; no sustain pedal warmth. Intimate and mortal.
Color Grade
Near-monochrome — deep blue-grey shadows with crushed blacks. Highlights pulled to pale silver. Skin tones drained to grey. Low contrast in the mids, hard contrast in the darks.
Post FX
Heavy 16mm film grain baked into the shadows. Cold blue-white light leak bleeding from the window edge. Subtle vignette pulling focus inward. Edges of the frame slightly soft — memory already distorting perception.
Cold GradeHeavy Grain
Solo PianoInterior · Night
40–48 bpm
Scene 02
The Bridge at Golden Hour
Music
Piano melody joined by finger-picked acoustic guitar — unhurried, breathing together like a conversation. Warmer reverb, more bloom. A gentle swell as they watch the water, then silence before a note resolves.
Color Grade
First warmth enters the palette. Amber and honey bloom in the highlights; shadows still carry cool undertones. The stream catches light like liquid copper. Soft halation around the figures.
Post FX
Fine grain, softer than Scene 1. Warm amber light leak from the right edge. Very subtle highlight bloom — like a half-remembered feeling. Slight temporal softness on motion, just below slow-motion.
Transitional GradeFine Grain
Piano + GuitarExterior · Dusk
58–66 bpm
Scene 03
A Wave Across Time
Music
Piano returns — higher register, lighter, almost childlike. Guitar falls away. Quiet, open, no heavy processing. In the final bars the melody slows to a single sustained note, fading to silence and birdsong.
Color Grade
Full warmth realised — the richest frame of the film. Deep golds, luminous greens, highlights carrying a dreamlike halo. Sky bleeds into warm white at the edges. Shadows lifted and gentle — no harshness remains.
Post FX
Minimal grain — texture almost gone, the image pure feeling. Strong warm light leak from the top-left. Gentle lens halo around the child. The man's edges softly diffused — already fading, returning. Slow dissolve to white.
Warm GradeMinimal Grain
Solo PianoExterior · Afternoon
72 bpm
